# ToolMaster

> Free, privacy-first PDF tool suite — 34+ tools that run 100% client-side in the browser, with zero file uploads to any server.

ToolMaster provides merge, split, compress, convert, sign, watermark, and password-protection tools for PDF files. Every tool processes documents entirely in the user's browser using JavaScript and WebAssembly — no file is ever uploaded to a server, making it a privacy-focused, zero-leakage alternative to typical online PDF utilities.

## Core PDF Tools

### Organize PDF
- [Merge PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one single document in any order.
- [Split PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/split-pdf): Extract individual pages or custom page ranges into separate PDFs.
- [Reorder PDF Pages](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/reorder-pdf): Rearrange and reorder pages of your PDF with live visual thumbnails.
- [Delete PDF Pages](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/delete-pages): Remove unwanted, blank, or duplicate pages from your PDF file.
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/rotate-pdf): Rotate PDF pages permanently 90°, 180°, or 270° clockwise or counter-clockwise.
- [Crop PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/crop-pdf): Trim margins, headers, or footers from PDF pages to fit any canvas.
- [Extract Images from PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/extract-images): Extract all high-resolution pages and embedded images as a ZIP archive.
- [Insert Image into PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/insert-pdf-image): Append or merge photos and graphics directly into an existing PDF.

### Convert PDF
- [PDF to JPG](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/pdf-to-jpg): Convert each PDF page into high-quality JPG images downloaded as a ZIP.
- [PDF to PNG](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/pdf-to-png): Export PDF pages to lossless PNG images with transparent/clean backgrounds.
- [JPG to PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/jpg-to-pdf): Convert multiple JPG, PNG, and WEBP pictures into a unified PDF file.
- [Word to PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/word-to-pdf): Convert DOCX documents into clean, non-editable PDF format.
- [PDF to Word](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/pdf-to-word): Extract structured text and formatting from PDF into an editable DOCX file.
- [Excel to PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/excel-to-pdf): Convert Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xls, .csv) to printable PDF reports.
- [PDF to Excel](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/pdf-to-excel): Extract tables and structured data from PDF into an editable XLSX spreadsheet.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/powerpoint-to-pdf): Convert presentation slides (.pptx, .ppt, images) into a seamless PDF slide deck.
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/pdf-to-powerpoint): Convert PDF document pages into an editable Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation.
- [HTML to PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/html-to-pdf): Render HTML code, formatted snippets, or web content into a styled PDF.
- [PDF to HTML](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/pdf-to-html): Convert PDF layout and formatted content into clean HTML5 markup.
- [TXT to PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/txt-to-pdf): Convert plain text, markdown, or code logs into formatted PDF documents.
- [PDF to Text](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/pdf-to-text): Extract all raw and formatted text from any PDF document.
- [CSV to PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/csv-to-pdf): Convert comma-separated CSV files into styled, formatted PDF tables.
- [PDF to PDF/A](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/pdf-to-pdfa): Standardize PDF files into ISO-compliant PDF/A format for long-term archiving.
- [PDF to Grayscale](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/pdf-to-grayscale): Convert colored PDF documents to crisp black & white / grayscale for printing.

### Edit & Sign
- [Add Watermark](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/add-watermark): Add custom text or image watermarks with full opacity, angle, and position control.
- [Add Page Numbers](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/add-page-numbers): Insert customized page numbers into header or footer with customizable formats.
- [Stamp PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/stamp-pdf): Overlay business stamps like APPROVED, CONFIDENTIAL, PAID, or custom labels.
- [Edit PDF Metadata](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/edit-metadata): Modify Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, and Creation Date properties.
- [Sign PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/sign-pdf): Draw, type, or upload your signature and place it anywhere on your PDF.
- [Flatten PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/flatten-pdf): Merge interactive form fields, layers, and annotations into static non-editable page content.
- [Repair PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/repair-pdf): Recover and repair corrupted, damaged, or unreadable PDF structures.

### PDF Security & Optimization
- [Protect PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/protect-pdf): Encrypt your PDF with standard passwords and security restrictions.
- [Unlock PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/unlock-pdf): Remove password protection and permissions security from your PDF.
- [Compress PDF](https://www.freetoolmaster.online/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size while maintaining optimal visual clarity.
